notes: d1-omni-600M converted to raw LiteRT graphs for the repository litert-community/d1-omni-600M-LiteRT (landed 2026-10-09, DECISIONS #194); source LiquidAI/d1-omni-600M @ 414f8d6438174f5b2133a9c21a478fc42625e308 (LFM Open License v1.0). A decision model: typed questions (noul / choice / score) over a text, an image or an audio clip -> calibrated probabilities; it never generates text. Twelve graphs, each tensor in / tensor out, with the tokenizer, the mel front end, the image tiling / resize / unshuffle and the read-out on the host: decide_<L> for L128 / 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096, the vision tower, the projector and audio_<T> for T501 / 1001 / 2001 / 3001. The shipped decision, tower and audio files carry the lane's fp16-safe norm rewrite (the pre-rewrite decision files collapse in fp16 arithmetic on this phone: every row uniform on OpenCL FP16_WITH_FP32_ACCUM in round 5, 19 of 20 rows non-finite on the HTP in round 10 leg N3); legs on pre-rewrite or other bytes are not records. This file: d1-omni-600M_audio_T1001_fp16.tflite (225525600 B) = the lane's work file d1_omni_work/out/d1omni_audio_T1001_f16safe_fp16.tflite (hard link; d1_omni_work/results/ship_manifest.json, round 13), audio graph audio_1001 (mel float32 [1,128,1001] + mel_valid / v1 / v2 / v3 masks -> prefix float32 [1,T3,1024], rows 0 .. P-1 used); storage in the lane's words 'fp16 FC weights, conv / BatchNorm / position constants fp32', with the fp16-safe LayerNorm rewrite at 31 of 87 sites (k = 1-4). artifact_sha256 = the manifest's sha256; every phone leg below pushed this file with a sha256 check, phone = Mac = artifact_sha256 (round 12: 'push d1omni_audio_T1001_f16safe_fp16.tflite rc=0 bytes 225525600/225525600 sha256 phone=dfeb70cf12108d28425ebe88a861b179a0a7d727839b93d508129eb9a97a2303 mac=dfeb70cf12108d28425ebe88a861b179a0a7d727839b93d508129eb9a97a2303 MATCH in 7s' (d1_omni_work/device/r12/s_graphs.txt)). Records: one per leg on these bytes (DECISIONS #193, the #187 way); machine_label galaxy-s26-d1-omni-runner = the C-API runner (rounds 10 / 12 / 12b). Landed 2026-10-09 (DECISIONS #194): the file is on the Hub at litert-community/d1-omni-600M-LiteRT (main = cada23ec117a81e79402b48ed6aeffaad0b700ec, public since 2026-10-09 02:07 JST); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 (anonymous API read 2026-10-09 11:00 JST). soc from the phone's own QNN line 'prepare_options.cc:342:STAT: soc_type=SM8850' (d1_omni_work/device/r10/N1_npu_f16s_L128.logcat_all.txt). d1_omni_work = ~/code/litertlm-convert/d1_omni_work; lane record: d1_omni_work/ROUND9.md, ROUND10.md, ROUND12.md, ROUND13.md, SPEED_LADDER.md.
